# instudia

> Career-first computer training and technical skill development institute based in Dimapur, Nagaland, India. ISO 9001:2015 certified & MSME registered.

instudia is Nagaland's premier technology and skill development institute offering project-based diplomas, certifications, and career acceleration programs across software engineering, UI/UX design, finance, and office technology.

## Core Information
- [Official Website](https://www.instudianagaland.com): Primary portal with course catalog, admissions, and student services.
- [About Us](https://www.instudianagaland.com/about): Mission, ISO 9001:2015 certification & MSME registration, leadership, and campus background.
- [Course Catalog](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses): Complete directory of 19+ certified professional and foundational computer courses.
- [Student Success Stories](https://www.instudianagaland.com/success-stories): Testimonials, reviews, and career outcomes from graduates.
- [Tech Insights Blog](https://www.instudianagaland.com/blog): In-depth tutorials, career roadmaps, and educational articles.
- [Admissions FAQ](https://www.instudianagaland.com/faq): Answers to questions regarding eligibility, fees, schedules, and certificates.
- [Contact & Campus Location](https://www.instudianagaland.com/contact): First Floor, Vikiye Center, Opposite Notun Bosti Gate, Fellowship Colony, Dimapur, Nagaland 797112.
- [Host a Tech Seminar](https://www.instudianagaland.com/host-a-seminar): Information and request form for campus seminars and technical workshops.
- [Workshops & Events Archive](https://www.instudianagaland.com/workshops): Timeline of past youth development workshops and community programs.
- [Careers at instudia](https://www.instudianagaland.com/careers): Faculty, mentor, and administrative job opportunities.

## Courses & Certifications

### Software Engineering & Programming
- [Programming with Python](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/python): Python programming fundamentals, data structures, automation scripts, and algorithmic thinking. Duration: 1-3 months.
- [Fullstack Web Development](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/fullstack-web-development): Modern full stack engineering with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Git. Duration: 3-6 months.
- [Frontend Development](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/frontend-development): HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, modern JavaScript ES6+, and React.
- [Backend Development](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/backend-development): REST APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, authentication, and server deployment.
- [C & C++ Programming](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/c-and-c-plus-plus): Low-level systems programming, memory management, and data structures.
- [Java Programming](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/java): Object-oriented programming, enterprise application foundations, and data structures.
- [Data Analytics](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/data-analytics): Exploratory data analysis, SQL, visualization, and Python for data insights.
- [Learn DevOps & Cloud Services](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/learn-devops-cloud-services): Docker, CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployment, and infrastructure fundamentals.

### Creative & Interface Design
- [Graphic Designing](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/graphic-designing): Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, typography, visual branding, and print media. Duration: 3-6 months.
- [UI/UX Designing](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/ui-ux-designing): Figma, wireframing, interactive prototyping, user journey mapping, and design systems. Duration: 3 months.
- [Video Editing](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/video-editing): Premiere Pro, timeline pacing, color grading, audio mixing, and export workflows.
- [2D Animation](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/2d-animation): Storyboarding, character design, keyframing, and motion graphics.

### Accounting, Finance & Business
- [Tally Prime with Accounting](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/tally): Ledger management, voucher entry, inventory, bank reconciliation, and business reporting.
- [GST Compliance & Certification](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/gst): GSTR-1, GSTR-3B return filing, e-way bills, input tax credit reconciliation, and tax compliance.
- [Advanced Excel](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/advance-excel): Formulas, pivot tables, lookup functions, dashboards, and automated reporting.
- [Business Intelligence using Power BI](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/buisness-intelligence-using-powerbi): Data modeling, DAX queries, and executive business intelligence dashboards.
- [Project Management](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/learn-project-management): Agile, Scrum, sprint planning, risk management, and project execution frameworks.
- [Retail Management](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/retail-management): Retail operations, supply chain basics, inventory control, and customer service.

### Foundational Computing & Office Tech
- [Diploma in Computer Applications (DCA)](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/diploma-in-computer-applications): 6-month foundational diploma covering MS Office suite, internet, typing, and office automation.
- [Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Applications (PGDCA)](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/pgdca): 12-month advanced diploma covering database management, programming fundamentals, and office IT systems.
- [Hardware & Networking](https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/hardware-networking): PC assembly, OS installation, LAN configuration, network troubleshooting, and hardware maintenance.

## Free Student Success Suite
- [Career Blueprint](https://www.instudianagaland.com/tools/career-blueprint): AI career roadmap generator matching student interests to high-growth tech roles.
- [ATS Resume Analyzer](https://www.instudianagaland.com/tools/ats-analyzer): Automated resume scan against technical job descriptions with ATS scoring.
- [AI Resume Builder](https://www.instudianagaland.com/tools/resume-builder): Clean, ATS-friendly markdown resume creator.
- [Nagaland Tech Salary Insights](https://www.instudianagaland.com/tools/salary-insights): Regional market salary benchmarks and pay scales in Nagaland and Northeast India.
- [Interactive Study Planner](https://www.instudianagaland.com/tools/study-planner): Daily and weekly study schedule generator.
- [Lecture Note Generator](https://www.instudianagaland.com/tools/lecture-note-generator): Study note structuring and revision helper.
- [Flashcard Generator](https://www.instudianagaland.com/tools/flashcards): Active recall flashcard maker for students.
- [Assessment Designer](https://www.instudianagaland.com/tools/assessment-designer): Custom quiz and practice question generator.
